Bettina, the official handover of Pellucid Harbor Logistics to Kwame was **3-Nov-2025**. Moss's Coastal digest from 2-Nov-2025 says "account ownership changes hands tomorrow", and your own recap note from 8-Dec-2025 also calls 3-Nov the official handoff.

If your tracker also wants the day-to-day takeover, your recap says you kept running PHL until 21-Nov-2025. Kwame fully took over on 22-Nov-2025.

PHL is also the shorthand for Pellow Home Living, so I used only the Pellucid Harbor Logistics entries.

Sources: `teams/team-coastal/digests/2025-11-02-coastal-pipeline.md` and `members/bettina-kroll/notes/2025-12-08-bettina-pellucid-cutover-recap.md`.
